items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: One of the Sheldon brothers is the one who really saved my life from getting killed

ctx.x: know if... They was going to set these guys up and they was gonna kill some of them, of the Shulman Gang -- which they did. If you read the history of Gangsterism, this was a prominent gang. The Eagle Rats from St. Louis used to come there. I met Al Capone there, I met his brother Ralph, and I met some of the guys from the Purple Gang in Detroit. Because they all used to come there and drink, and I used to talk to them.

One of the Sheldon brothers is the one who really saved my life from getting killed, because the guy had a gun right at my head and was going to kill me. Because one of the guys in the band, the piano player, put out a rumor that we was posin' as musicians, but we was actually a part of the gang and part of Charlie Berger's bodyguards. So these guys laid for us. Like I said, it's a whole chapter almost.

So anyway, after I got in all that trouble, I says, "I'm leaving here." And I told Charlie, I said, "No. If you can, try to get me a Billboard while I'm in the hospital recuperating." He said, "Okay, I'll get you one."
